candidate_labels: primary malignant melanoma of the oesophagus

primary malignant melanoma of the oesoph: Biopsy results: infiltrating malignant tumour with prominent nucleoli and cells prominent in the submucosa and basal layer of the squamous mucosa
FDG PET/CT body scan finding: increased uptake in a high abdominal pre-aortic and high right paratracheal node consistent with metastasis
Oesophagoscopy finding: large polypoid pigmented lesion at 30 cm
Symptoms: regurgitation and unintentional weight loss of 14 kg
CT scan finding: well-defined eccentric mass in the mid-lower oesophagus
Chief complaint: 3-month history of increasing difficulty swallowing solid foods
